releases.title: A button people want on their site
changes: The form on your site wears your cover, logo, title and words, in light, dark or your visitors' own theme.
The button eases in, lifts on hover and turns into a close cross; the panel springs open and grows with what's in it. On a phone it's a sheet from the bottom.
An optional star rating, with faces that cheer up as the stars go up. The inbox filters by it and Stats show the average.
A Design tab for the look, with a preview that runs the real button on a stand-in page, at a computer's width or a phone's.
Set up shows where the button is live, with sites to allow in a tap. The snippet is one short line, and changes need no new one.
Dropdowns, switches and segmented controls drawn to match the app, and a copy button joined to every snippet.
"Bug" is now "Issue", which suits more kinds of trouble.
This changelog.

releases.title: A form of your own
changes: Ask for an email or a phone number, optional or required.
Add up to eight questions: a short answer, a dropdown, one choice or checkboxes.
Filter the inbox by kind, by any answer, by photos or by words.
Each item is a thread for your team: notes and every change, in order.

releases.title: For places and events
changes: A project can be for a restaurant, a shop or an event: Praise, Problem and Idea.
On a phone, one tap opens the camera, and a photo alone is enough to send.
Your feedback page gets a title, description, logo and cover.
Stats count QR scans and email visits on their own; Share can email the link.

releases.title: Link previews of its own
changes: A shared link shows feedback's title, words and picture.

releases.title: Quicker tabs
changes: The button carries the app's smiling-bubble mark.
Switching a project's tabs changes only what's below them.

releases.title: A page of its own
changes: A feedback page at your own address, with votes and comments you approve.
Files on feedback: pictures, videos, PDFs and text.
A QR code and a poster to print.
Stats per project and for your account; light, dark or system theme.

releases.title: A face for the app
changes: A smiling speech bubble for the icon, the favicon and the sign-in page.

releases.title: Keys for agents
changes: API keys, so a script or a coding agent can set up a project and sort its inbox.

releases.title: A feedback button for any website
changes: One script tag adds a button and a small form to any site.
An inbox per project, tinted by status, with private notes.
A public board of the items you choose, with votes.
